Title: The food was...
Review:
The food was amazing, as always.

The only reason I’m not giving 5 stars is because of the experience we had when we arrived. We got there at 8:25 PM.

Instead of greeting us, asking how many people were in our party, or simply saying good evening, the hostess immediately gave me a “warning” that they were closing at 9 PM. I told her that was completely fine and that we would be quick. She told me to head upstairs, and before going up I mentioned that we were a party of 5.

She then proceeded to make an eye-roll 🙄 right in front of me and turned around. Honestly, I was pretty upset by her attitude and the face she made, so I asked if it was actually okay for us to dine there or if there was a reason for such a rude attitude. I was honestly very close to leaving, but I decided to stay because I wanted to mention the situation to the manager on duty.

The manager had a completely different attitude. He told us that even if it had been 9 PM already, they would still be happy to welcome us.

Our waiter was extremely kind. We ordered quickly to be respectful of the time and even asked for the check early, but he reassured us there was no rush and mentioned they often stay later than usual anyway.

That completely changed the experience for us, which is why I’m giving 4 stars instead of less. The manager and our waiter truly turned things around, and I sincerely appreciate them.

Title: This restaurant is...
Review:
This restaurant is based on the concept of the shrimp fisherman from the movie Forrest Gump who made his fortune in shrimp fishing and opened a shop.
In Las Vegas, it's located inside Planet Hollywood.
There's a staircase leading upstairs from inside the souvenir shop, and once you go up, you'll find a very spacious area.
This time, we ate in a large booth.
The staff were incredibly friendly, asking things like, "How's the food?" and "Is there anything you need?"
For our meal, we chose shrimp ajillo and fried shrimp, lobster, and white fish.
Both were delicious.
We were able to take home the drink glasses as souvenirs, which made for a nice memento.
By showing our receipt at the souvenir shop on the first floor, we received a brand new, light-up LED cup.
They also have branches in Japan, so I highly recommend it to shrimp lovers!
Original Content:
フォレストガンプの映画に出てくるエビ漁で成功してショップを出店したコンセプトでお店が作られています。
ラスベガスではプラネットハリウッドの中にあります。
お土産屋さんの中に上に上がれる階段があり、登るとかなり広い空間があります。
今回は大きめのボックス席で食事をしました。

店員さんもすごく感じが良く、味はどうだい？何か必要なものはないかい？とすごくフレンドリーでした。
食事はエビのアヒージョとエビ、ロブスター、白身魚のフライをチョイスしました。
どちらもとても美味しかったです。
飲み物のグラスはお土産として持ち帰ることができ、こちらも良い記念となりました。
1階のお土産屋さんでレシートを見せると新品の光るLEDのカップを頂くことができました。
日本にも店舗があるので、エビ好きの方にはオススメです！

Review: I hadn’t been to Bubba Gump in a long time and wanted to try out the Vegas location. I didn’t recall and was very disappointed that the shrimp and fish were the breaded kind you can find in the frozen food section in a grocery store. My shrimp basket only contained about 5 shrimp and 1 strip of battered fish. I guess my expectations are higher being a Louisiana native. My husband’s ribs were thin and mostly bone. We spent $30 for each dish with a $10 icee(my fault for ordering). Our waiter was ok, but we wondered how the seating process worked as we noticed an odd pattern of how the hostess seated the people requesting the outside patio. The music was a great combination that we received well. Overall, we tried it out and that’s that.
